edits.new:
Then the loading state of SCR-46 is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P10-E1063-APP-10)

  Scenario: AC9 Feed, schedule, tables and aggregate shape (new; BR7, BR8, BR10, BR11)
    Given the Schedule AgentRunDailyRollup runs for business date 2026-12-01
    When the rollup completes
    Then the reporting feed is built from rwb.agent.AgentRunCompleted.v1 on rwb.agent.events.v1 with no lake table, extract or lake credential written
    Then the daily aggregate holds agent, policy version, prompt version, model version, business date, runs, answered, fallback, fallback rate, latency p50, latency p95, tokens, cost and the latest evaluation score
    Then only agent_alert and the daily aggregate rows of the business date are written in rwb_agent

  Scenario: AC10 Error answers 401, 403 and 404 of the provided operations (new)
    Given a request to the metric read arrives without a valid credential
    When the route receives the read
    Then the route answers 401 with the message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P10-E1063-APP-AC10)
    Given a role without the reporting read opens the dashboard
    When the route receives the read
    Then the route refuses the read with 403 and MSG-P4-002
    Given a metric read names an agent that does not exist
    When the route receives the read
    Then the route answers 404 with the message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P10-E1063-APP-AC10)

  Scenario: AC11 Activity retry and timeout (new)
    Given the aggregateAgentRuns activity fails once with a retryable error for 2026-12-01
    When the workflow retries the activity
    Then the daily rows for 2026-12-01 are replaced, not added, and no second alert exists
    Given the aggregateAgentRuns activity runs longer than its timeout of Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P10-E1063-APP-AC11)
    When the timeout fires
    Then the rollup run reports failed and the business date is started again by hand through the same workflow ID

  Scenario: AC12 A disallowed status change is refused (new)
    Given an alert row for "SCREENING" has sent_at set
    When a change sets sent_at back to empty
    Then the change is refused and sent_at keeps its value
